stem: Which sentence best shows that the makers of the new Big Tex hoped to keep a problem from happening again?

options.label: A
options.text: Overall, the new Big Tex would be more lifelike. (paragraph 7)

options.label: B
options.text: In fact, they used a secret code for Big Tex in emails and on the phone. (paragraph 8)

options.label: C
options.text: The workers were careful to use materials that would not burn easily. (paragraph 9)

options.label: D
options.text: His steel-frame body was taken to a clothing factory. (paragraph 10)
